    # Clear the search filter by filling the searchbox with empty string and pressing Enter
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await searchbox.fill('')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')
    # Wait for the page to reload with all projects
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # Search for 'Pytorch GAN' in the searchbox
    await searchbox.fill('Pytorch GAN')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # Look for the Pytorch GAN repo link in the main area
    # Use .filter() to ensure we select the correct link within the main area
    pytorch_gan_link = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='Pytorch GAN')
    await pytorch_gan_link.click()

    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
